summary: the ten probes of probe_roots.sh on a KRFFS and an ext2 root, on i686, with three faults in ext2's links and statistics

argv: make -s rach2 krffs test-image build/tests/system/harness build/tests/system/runutil build/tools/image/mkmbr ARCH=i686 </dev/null && cp build/rach2/kernel ${WORK}/kernel
status=0; for root in krffs ext2; do sh tests/system/probe_roots.sh ${WORK}/kernel ${WORK}/${PHASE}/$root $root || status=1; done; exit $status
